title: Wayfare Pass Member Standing and the Billing-Error Make-Good Rate on Wayfare Rides Fares
content:
When a fare charge on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** was billed above the guaranteed fare, the make-good rate for the billing error follows the rider's standing as a paying member of **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)**. The standing is read from the Wayfare Pass membership in force at the request: its enrollment date, and the membership fee charges booked on it in the last 12 months.

## Schedule of make-good rates by member standing

| Standing | Enrolled before today | Membership fee charges booked on it in the last 12 months | Make-good rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Long-standing member | at least 24 months | at least $150.00 | 10 percent (0.10) |
| Established member | at least 12 months but fewer than 24 months | at least $90.00 | 5 percent (0.05) |
| Any other rider | — | — | not changed by member standing |

A long-standing member is a membership enrolled at least 24 months before today on which membership fee charges of at least $150.00 were booked in the last 12 months; it takes the long-standing member make-good rate of 10 percent. An established member is a membership enrolled at least 12 months but fewer than 24 months before today on which fee charges of at least $90.00 were booked in the last 12 months; it takes the established member make-good rate of 5 percent. For any other rider, member standing does not change the make-good rate.

## Combinations on the two conditions

| Months enrolled | Fee charges in the last 12 months | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | $150.00 or more | 10 percent |
| 24 or more | below $150.00 | not changed (24 months or more is outside the established band, and the fees are short of $150.00) |
| at least 12, fewer than 24 | $90.00 or more | 5 percent |
| at least 12, fewer than 24 | below $90.00 | not changed |
| fewer than 12 | any amount | not changed |
| no membership in force at the request | — | not changed |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical memberships)

- Enrolled exactly 24 months before today with $150.00 in fee charges in the last 12 months: both thresholds are met, 10 percent. With $149.99: the long-standing band fails, and at 24 months the established band fails too.
- Enrolled 11 months before today with $200.00 in fee charges: fewer than 12 months, so neither band applies.
